title: statespace receipt, version 1
description: The Bench's report of what real tools said about one lab stage (spine section 9.4; ARCHITECTURE.md section 10). statespace check and statespace trace validate write it to receipts/ in the learner's lab repository; INS-receipt imports it on the instrument origin, where it yields stamps and claims, never evidence of learning. A receipt never trusts an exit code alone: every runs[] entry carries the verdict lines verbatim, and the importer re-derives each verdict from them. A file may carry only the lanes reported (shown as reported from your machine) and self-assessed; only the tab assigns re-checked here, at read time, to checks it re-ran itself, so that badge is never stored in a receipt. Statement hashes follow statement-hash@1 (defs.schema.json), and a changed hash voids the claim to [?]. The receipt version, the hash rule and the rule that versions are recorded verbatim never change in place (labs/TOOLS.md section 6.4). Fields are camelCase as spine section 9.4 writes them, except reason_unknown, which is Z3's own name.

stage.description: The lab stage the receipt reports, such as LAB-2.2. It must belong to lab; the importer checks that (ARCHITECTURE.md section 10.3, step 5).

lane.description: reported (badge: reported from your machine) when the CLI ran the checks; self-assessed when the learner judged them. re-checked here is not a value: the tab assigns it at read time and never stores it.

createdAt.description: When the CLI wrote the receipt.

cli.description: The CLI that wrote the receipt.

environment.description: Where the checks ran. The sandbox is recorded, never required (spine section 9.2).

devcontainer.description: The devcontainer image digest, or null when the stage ran outside it (LAB-1 runs under uv).

os.description: The operating system the tools ran on, and the CPU architecture.

arch.description: The CPU architecture, such as x86_64 or aarch64.

sandbox.description: on: built, exported and checked inside bubblewrap; off: run without it; failed: wanted and could not start (labs/TOOLS.md section 4).

sandboxDetail.description: The sandbox's own error line, verbatim, when sandbox is failed.

tools.description: Every tool the checks ran, with its version verbatim and the SHA-256 of its binary, jar or wheel.

statements.description: The pinned statements the checks were about, each with its statement hash (I7).

runs.description: One entry per tool execution, in the order the CLI ran them.

checks.description: The stage's checks and whether each passed. Every id belongs to lab (ARCHITECTURE.md section 10.3, step 5).

claims.description: The claim cards to mint or update in the lab repository, by template or by the learner's id.

tcb.description: The trusted computing base of the stage's guarantee: each component and how it is backed.

attestation.description: A Sigstore attestation; absent by default (OD-13).

ext.description: Forward-compatible extras. The stamp deriver ignores them.

tool.description: A tool that ran: lean, lake, tlc, java, z3, cvc5, postgres, souffle, cargo.

version.description: The tool's own version string, verbatim (cvc5's pip wheel prints 1.4.2-modified; keep it).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the binary, jar or wheel that ran.

pinned.description: Whether sha256 equals the course's pin for this tool. False flags the tool as unpinned; the check still runs (labs/TOOLS.md section 6.2).

statement.description: A pinned statement and its statement hash.

path.description: The statement file in the lab repository.

kind.description: lean-challenge (a challenge module), tla, smt2, yaml (a claim file) or sql.

sha256.description: sha256(trimRight(text) + "\n"), statement-hash@1: Comparator Live's challenge hash.

run.description: One tool execution. The verdict is re-derived from verdictLines on import; a disagreement rejects the receipt.

step.description: The pipeline step this execution is, such as build, axioms, check or comparator.

argv.description: The exact command line, flags included.

inputSha256.description: SHA-256 of the input the engine read.

budget.description: The run's budget: rlimit for Z3, workers for TLC, the seed for seeded runs. Empty when the run had none.

exitCode.description: Recorded, never read alone: lake comparator exits 1 both on a rejection and when bubblewrap cannot start under default Docker [X RUN-lean-bwrap-docker].

verdictLines.description: The lines that carry the verdict, copied verbatim from the tool's output.

verdict.description: The verdict the CLI parsed from verdictLines.

lean.description: The Lean section: what the kernel and the other checkers said, which axioms each theorem uses, and how the statement was checked.

toolchain.description: The lean-toolchain line, such as leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0.

challengeSha.description: The statement hash of the challenge module.

checkers.description: One row per checker that ran, the --paranoid ones included.

theorems.description: Axioms per theorem, as #print axioms lists them.

nativeAxioms.description: Axioms introduced by native_decide or bv_decide (the _native ones).

sorryCount.description: Declarations that use sorry. A file with sorry still builds with exit code 0 [X RUN-lean-axioms].

automation.description: Which automation closed goals, so a stamp can say so (M-manual-mode).

statementCheck.description: comparator, goldens, or weak, which renders as "statement check: weak".

goldens.description: The kernel-checked goldens behind a goldens statement check.

lints.description: Lint findings, such as a flagged declare_syntax_cat.

goldens.description: A run of a pool of kernel-checked goldens: the pool's hash and the counts.

tlc.description: The TLC section. A stop at "Deadlock reached" ends exploration early, so it is never complete.

constants.description: The constants as the configuration assigns them, verbatim.

flags.description: TLC's flags as passed, such as -workers 1 and -deadlock.

complete.description: Whether exploration covered the whole reachable state space.

traceFile.description: The JSON or text trace TLC wrote.

z3.description: The Z3 section. entry records whether the query went through the SMT-LIB command line or the Python API, because the two can answer differently [X RUN-z3-11179].

reason_unknown.description: Z3's reason_unknown, verbatim, when the verdict is unknown.

historySha256.description: The hash of the history@1 file statespace isorun wrote.

sqlstateClasses.description: SQLSTATE code to count, such as 40001 or 22003.

rls.description: Row-level security: the role the statements ran as, the policy's hash, how many read-backs were compared and how many disagreed.

traces.description: Trace validation (statespace trace validate): how many traces, the hash of the seed list, and each trace's verdict with its first non-conforming line.

trace.description: The trace file in the lab repository.

firstNonConformingLine.description: The 1-based NDJSON line where the trace stops conforming; null when it conforms.

datalog.description: The Datalog section: the engine, a hash per computed relation, the derivation checks and the generator's statistics.

relations.description: Relation name to the SHA-256 of its sorted tuples.

generator.description: The generator's statistics, as the generator reports them.

pairs.description: A paired-state check: the hashes of the witness, the relation and the observer, and the bound it ran under (I10).

bound.description: The bound as the stamp prints it, such as the domain and n.

provenance.description: Self-reported provenance (OD-8). It sets the weight of the receipt-import event and nothing else.

agent.description: Whether a coding agent worked in the repository, self-reported.

guard.description: off when the agent-guardrail hook was switched off with STATESPACE_GUARD=off.

claim.description: A claim card to mint or update.

id.description: The learner's id for the card.
